files.twin.yaml:

twin:
  id: three-tier-dc-manual
  description: "Three-tier DC built by hand on the canvas: 2 core + 2 aggregation L3 switches (VyOS, OSPF area 0), 3 dual-homed racks"
  containment: uncontained
  tiers:
    te:
      default: te.yaml
    tfc:
      default: tfc/default.yaml
